connector.name: SQL
connector.registryDescription: Read-only SQL querying + schema introspection over Postgres & SQLite, with a gated write mode.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sql. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the abhishekkumar2021 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: DB_CONN_default
env.description: Connection URL for the 'default' connection (postgres://… or sqlite:/abs/path). Additional connections use DB_CONN_<name>. Carries credentials — treated as secret.

env.name: DB_WRITABLE
env.description: Set to 1 or true to enable the write tools (execute, execute_script).
